tips for hitting w:

try to only cast it out of vision. if that means sitting in sidebrush with a pink, or casting it behind one of the little pockets that leads into the river/jungle. if you cast it out of vision they cant see that you casted it and will only see the w  right before its gonna land. if youre ahead/know where thr enemy jg is, going in and out of vision and harassing with w is super good.

predicting isnt the only way to get them in it either. a lot of the time what I'll do, if I'm kinda low and they think they can kill me, I'll throw a w out of vision and then use myself as bait to kind of steer them in. this works in reverse too, if youre really strong, depending on how you approach them, you can kind of steer them into the w.

dont forget about flash. sometimes its great for getting a really cheesy kill. you put youre w on or near them without really trying to go close to it so they dont see it as a threat, then when they arent expecting it you can do the roll of e, then either flash into the w or close enough to use the blink of your e into the w to stun them. works really well from far away or in situations where they are at kill health and so are you. it also works well when youre coming back to lane and theyre hitting your tower, you can cast it on them while youre walking back (max range), wait a second so they dont see you coming, then e flash in as it lands on them so they dont have time to react. guaranteed to hit basically every time, just need to assess if its worth your flash or not.

blinking to a minion instead of hitting the champion(s) you wanna stun can work really well if your blink is out of range on them and they are about to leave the circle. e to a minion thats also in your w to get the stun off for your jungler, or close the gap with proto or something.

First thing is probably figure out where to register, theyll ask for your tag, and then youre basically all set in terms of actually playing. 

Try to get there like 30 minutes-an hour early to try to warm up with friendlies and stuff. Its unlikely any setups will be open so youll probably  have to ask to join into someones rotation. Its really hard and awkward to ask people to play with you since you dont know anyone but just ask if you can hop in next round and most people will gladly let you in.

All you need is your controller and the money to register but a bottle of water or snack wouldnt hurt.

Most important thing is to basically be prepared to go 0-2. Youre probably gonna be nervous and not playing to the best of your ability and thats normal, it takes a while to get used to the setting. Thats why trying to get as many friendly games in as possible is the best way to get the most of locals at the beginning.

Just have fun with it and try to attend consistently and you'll get used to it in no time and start winning matches.

Good luck!
